notes.message: `state/irrelevant-field` names a field at a time, and this state has none to name.
The checks that compare questions need two to compare. This run carried 1, so they did not run.

cleared.advice_caveat: Blind testing found two-axis rubrics reading 0.72 to 0.80 and published-correct rubrics reading 0.62 to 0.76, so the two overlap and no trigger separates them. At 0.77 this fires on none of the published-correct material and on fewer than half the two-axis rubrics: a clear reading is not evidence the scale measures one quality.
